identity.title: Frozen Offline Independent Forecasting, Stratified Scoring and Price-Derived Comparator
identity.objective: Add one finite offline native source-grounded forecast and same-case scoring caller. Deterministic exogenous training-only p_yes or abstention; explicitly non-independent Wang price comparator; stratified freeze, Brier/logloss, denominators, cold verification, WP170 boundary and R3-LEARN-01 handoff. No provider/model/market network, registry mutation, strategy, paper or trade authority.
